integrity: Universal result is proved analytically. Finite exact checker results corroborate but do not prove all-size claims. Earliest exact-day accessible publication in cited primary context is 2005-12-19; an older 2002 work has only year-level source evidence.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted-window paths only; strictly positive edge variation weights; no claim for multidimensional or noninterval windows; the all-depth cascade assertion is unweighted. Earlier literature could contain an implicit equivalent, especially in uninspected complete older publications.
title: Finite-window morphology: sharp two-input variation and a boundary-weight transition
